sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S. INDIRESH  ORAL ORDER
Sri. Ravindranath B., learned Additional Government Advocate accepts notice for respondents.
2. In this writ petition, the petitioner-Committee is seeking direction to the respondents to pay compensation for acquiring the land in question for the purpose of NH-4.

3. Heard Sri. Chandrashekar G.M., learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Sri.
Ravindranath B., learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for respondents.

4. Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties and taking into account the factual aspects on record, I am of the view that the petitioner shall approach the respondent-Authorities,
seeking redressal of its grievance.

NC: 2024:KHC:45165 WP NO.21906 OF 2023 Hence, the petitioner-Committee is permitted to make a representation to the respondent-Authorities for redressal its grievance, within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of this order.
In the event, if the petitioner-Committee makes such a representation, the respondent-Authorities shall consider the same in accordance with law at the earliest.
With these observations writ petition stands disposed of.

SD/-
(E.S. INDIRESH) JUDGE ARK Shri Veerabhadreshwara vs Special Land Acquisition Officer on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110400175/
